description: This Java class defines a simple log node filter called MessageOnlyLogFilter, which implements the LogNode interface. Its purpose is to filter out all log metadata and only pass the message to the next node in the logging chain. It provides methods to set and get the next log node, and overrides the println method to pass only the message with minimal metadata.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A filter class that only passes message content to the next log node, omitting other metadata.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that takes a LogNode object to chain logging nodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Overrides LogNode's println; passes only the message to the next node if present.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
